title: Part Time Bookkeeper
description:
Part-Time Bookkeeper
Location: Derby, office-based
Hours: Approx. 25 hours per week, with flexitime
Salary: Circa £14.50 per hour, depending on experience
Job Type: Part-time, Permanent
The Role
We are looking for an experienced Part-Time Bookkeeper to join a friendly and professional team based in Derby.
This is an excellent opportunity for an experienced Bookkeeper who is confident managing bookkeeping and VAT requirements for multiple clients. You'll need to be organised, comfortable working to deadlines and able to build positive relationships with clients.
Key Responsibilities as the new Part time Bookkeeper:
- Completing bookkeeping assignments for a varied portfolio of clients
- Preparing and submitting VAT returns accurately and within required deadlines
- Maintaining a VAT control system to ensure all information and returns are completed on time
- Ensuring compliance with relevant VAT regulations
- Managing workloads within agreed budgets and deadlines
- Using Sage Accounting Software to maintain accurate financial records
- Liaising directly with clients in a professional, friendly and helpful manner
- Working with clients both on and off-site when required

Skills & Experience as the new Part time Bookkeeper:
To be considered for this position, you should ideally have:
- A minimum of 2 years' bookkeeping experience
- At least 2 years' experience using Sage
- At least 2 years' experience preparing VAT returns
- Strong attention to detail and excellent organisational skills
- The ability to manage multiple deadlines effectively
- A proactive, approachable and helpful attitude
- Previous experience working with multiple clients
- AAT qualification or relevant practical experience
- Experience with Making Tax Digital (MTD) would be advantageous

Benefits
- Pension scheme
- Life insurance cover
- Up to 25 days' holiday, pro rata
- Free on-site car parking
- Flexible working hours

For more information or to apply, please contact Chloe

If you receive suspicious outreach claiming to be from us, please contact us via the ManpowerGroup website.

title: Temporary Data Administrator
description:
We are looking for a Data Administrator to join a busy data team, supporting the accurate creation, maintenance and validation of data across a range of business systems.

You'll play an important role in maintaining data quality, supporting data migration projects and providing day-to-day data administration and reporting support.

To be considered for the role, you'll require the following essentials:
- Experience working with data and maintaining accurate records.
- Strong organisational and communication skills.
- The ability to work independently and as part of a team.
- Experience using SAP, Salesforce and Microsoft Office.
- An understanding of data protection, confidentiality and compliance.
- A methodical approach and the ability to manage routine and ad-hoc tasks.

Within this position, you'll also be:
- Create, update and maintain master data records across business systems.
- Support data migration through data cleansing, validation and transformation.
- Identify and resolve duplicate, incomplete or inconsistent records.
- Complete daily report refreshes and respond to ad-hoc data requests.
- Maintain accurate records.
- Support the wider data team with queries, validation and routine activities.
- Assist with the creation and maintenance of training and data documentation.

Salary & Working Hours
- £13.07 per hour
- 20 days holiday plus banks
- Long term temporary opportunity with a view to becoming a permanent member of staff
- Opportunity to develop your data management experience.
- Exposure to data migration and business improvement projects.
- Supportive and collaborative team environment.
- Opportunity to work with a range of business systems and data.

title: Receptionist
description:
Receptionist - Mercedes-Benz Derby

Want to meet your potential and have a great time doing it ?

In this customer facing role you will be the first point of contact for all customers that come through our doors. You will have excellent communication, great organisational skills, and the ability to create a warm and welcoming environment.

As part of a successful, global automotive group, you'll broaden your experience across both sites and brands. And with the right support from us, you'll be able to progress as high as you can aim.

What we can offer you
- Enjoy 33 days (per Rota) of annual leave (including bank holidays) to rest and recharge
- Save money every day with our exclusive retail discounts
- Drive a great deal with discounts on new and used cars, plus servicing offers
- Plan for the years ahead with our company pension scheme
- Balance home and work with our industry-leading family-friendly policies designed to help you spend more time with the people that matter
- Commute for less with our cycle-to-work scheme
- Prioritise your wellbeing with dedicated support for you and your family
- 24/7 access to healthcare professionals, ensuring you get the expert advice you need quickly and easily
- Make a difference with a paid day to volunteer in your community
- Invest in your future with our company share purchase plan
- Earn financial rewards when you refer a friend to join the team
- Keep learning and growing with our training and development opportunities for everyone.
- Life assurance with the option to increase cover
- We're open to flexible working options - just ask

What you'll do day to day
- Greet and welcome customers and visitors in a friendly and professional manner
- Accurately record calls & visits, and relay messages in timely manner
- Perform general administrative duties, such as managing emails and handling customer enquiries
- Manage customer waiting area and showroom, ensuring a clean and welcoming environment
- Provide support with additional tasks as required to ensure smooth business operations

Helpful skills and qualifications

Don't worry about ticking off every single skill here if you care about delivering great experiences as much as we do, we want to hear from you.
- Demonstrated experience in a customer service role, with the ability to consistently deliver a positive customer experience
- Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with a friendly and professional manner
- Proven ability to multitask and perform well under pressure
- Excellent organisational skills, with strong attention to detail
- IT literate with proficiency in Microsoft Office and the ability to quickly learn new systems

We value diversity and believe it strengthens our team. If you don't meet every requirement listed but are enthusiastic about this role and eager to learn, we encourage you to apply.

Be part of something big

Group 1 Automotive is on an exciting growth journey. We are home to over 7000 colleagues dedicated to providing exceptional customer service, with 114 dealerships in the UK, representing 21 brands at the forefront of automotive retail.

But you don't need to love cars to work with us - just need to share our mission to create outstanding and trusted experiences for our customers, our partners, and our people.

Our Values

At Group 1 Automotive we pride ourselves on our five core values that are incorporated in all we that do.

Respect - Integrity - Transparency - Teamwork - Professionalism

These are the principles that every member of our team lives by, whether that be business functions, customer interactions, how we interact with the local community and even how we view each other in the team.

title: Credit Controller
description:
Our client, an organisation in central Derby, are looking for a credit controller for an immediate start to help out with their Local Authority ledger. You could be based at home for this role.

Client Details

Our client is a well established organisation in Derbyshire.

Description
- Manage credit control activity to keep customer account information accurate and current.
- Review outstanding balances and follow up on payments in a timely manner.
- Maintain clear records of customer contact, payment updates and account queries.
- Investigate account discrepancies and work towards practical resolutions.
- Update finance records accurately to support reliable reporting.
- Respond to customer queries professionally and provide clear information on balances.
- Work with the Accounting & Finance department to resolve payment-related issues.

Profile

A successful 'Credit Controller' should have:
- Experience of credit control and managing outstanding customer balances.
- The ability to maintain accurate financial records and payment information.
- Confidence investigating account queries and discrepancies.
- A clear and professional approach to communicating with customers.
- Good attention to detail when updating finance systems and records.
- The ability to organise tasks effectively within a temporary Credit Controller role.

Job Offer
- Temporary Credit Controller contract in Derby (but can work from home)
- Hourly pay of £14 to £17, dependent on the level of experience.

If you're interested in this role, apply now.

title: Marketing & Lettings Coordinator
company: H2O Recruitment Services Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Marketing & Lettings Coordinator

Location: Derby, Derbyshire

Salary: basic, with realistic OTE of £30,000-£35,000 depending on experience

Hours: Monday-Friday, 9:00am-5:30pm

Holiday: 21 days annual leave plus an additional day off for your birthday

Contract: Full-time, permanent

About the Opportunity

An exciting opportunity has arisen for a creative, enthusiastic and commercially minded Marketing & Lettings Coordinator to join a growing residential property business based in Derby.

This is a fantastic opportunity for someone with marketing experience who wants to take ownership of a company's marketing activities, introduce fresh ideas and play an important role in its continued growth.

The successful candidate will be responsible for developing the company's online presence, managing social media, maintaining website content and coordinating marketing campaigns.

Alongside marketing responsibilities, you will also receive full training in residential lettings, allowing you to develop additional commercial and property industry skills.

Initially, the role will be split approximately two days per week in marketing and three days supporting residential lettings, with the opportunity for marketing responsibilities to grow as the business expands.

Key Responsibilities

Marketing & Brand Development
- Take ownership of the company's marketing activities and help develop its marketing strategy.
- Establish, develop and manage social media channels.
- Create engaging content, including property posts, promotional materials and company updates.
- Plan and coordinate marketing campaigns to increase brand awareness and generate enquiries.
- Manage and regularly update the company website.
- Identify new opportunities to promote the business and its services.
- Introduce creative ideas to improve marketing performance and customer engagement.
- Work closely with the directors to develop marketing initiatives.
- Monitor campaign effectiveness and suggest improvements.

Residential Lettings

Full training will be provided. Responsibilities are expected to include:
- Assisting with the day-to-day running of the lettings department.
- Handling enquiries from prospective tenants and landlords.
- Arranging property viewings and supporting the lettings process.
- Assisting with property advertising and marketing.
- Maintaining accurate customer and property records.
- Supporting general lettings administration.
- Providing excellent customer service and building positive relationships with clients.

About You

Essential
- Previous experience in marketing, digital marketing or social media management.
- Strong creative skills and the confidence to introduce new ideas.
- Good knowledge of social media platforms and content creation.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
- Strong organisational skills and attention to detail.
- A proactive, enthusiastic and self-motivated approach.
- Confidence working independently and taking responsibility.
- A genuine willingness to learn residential lettings.
- Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills.

Desirable
- Experience in residential lettings, estate agency or property.
- Website content management experience.
- Experience creating and delivering marketing campaigns.
- A marketing qualification or relevant degree.

What's on Offer
- Basic salary negotiable
- Realistic OTE of £30,000-£35,000, depending on experience and commission.
- Opportunity to take ownership of the company's marketing function.
- Full training in residential lettings.
- A varied and rewarding position combining marketing and property.
- The opportunity to contribute ideas and make a genuine difference.
- Career development opportunities within a growing business.
- Monday-to-Friday working hours.
- 21 days' annual leave plus an additional birthday holiday.

Why Apply?

This is an excellent opportunity for someone looking to progress their marketing career while gaining valuable experience in the property industry.

You'll have the freedom to develop creative marketing ideas, build a company's online presence and become an integral part of an ambitious and expanding team.

If you're creative, motivated and looking for a role offering variety, responsibility and long-term potential, we'd love to hear from you.
